name: SIA "Puces datorsistemas"
notes:
PLDS (AS214507) is a Latvian network operated by SIA "Pūces datorsistēmas", a RIPE NCC member and Local Internet Registry (LIR).

We operate our own autonomous system and IP address space, using third-party infrastructure for upstream connectivity.

We welcome inquiries regarding BGP peering, IP connectivity and network interconnection.

Routing information is published in the RIPE Database under AS214507.
